$comment: Standard Webhooks v1 signatures: v1, + base64(HMAC-SHA256(secret bytes, webhook-id + '.' + webhook-timestamp + '.' + body)), one entry per secret, space-separated, in secret order. `body` is signed as its UTF-8 bytes. The first case is the published Standard Webhooks test vector (standard-webhooks/standard-webhooks go/webhook_test.go:233-238); the others were computed with node:crypto createHmac, independently of this package. The placeholders {{STANDARD_WEBHOOKS_TEST_SECRET}} (whsec_ plus the key) and {{STANDARD_WEBHOOKS_TEST_KEY}} (the base64 key MfKQ9r8GKY followed by qrTwjUPD8ILPZIo2LaLaSw) stand for the published Standard Webhooks test secret, kept out of the file as one literal because secret scanning flags it; readers substitute them before use.
